x: Our junior team of runners, Messrs Garland, Jacobs, Clubb and Thorne, by dead-heating in the Surrey Youths' Race with Mitcham A.C., showed that our younger members may be relied upon to uphold Belgrave prestige, and in time will prove worthy successors of the present seniors
In the team race Garland was placed fourth, Jacobs fifth, Clubb sixth, and Thorne seventh, aggregating 22 points, and thus tieing with Mitcham A C. for first place.
In the 4 x 220 yards we were fourth (Mewes, Bennett, Stower, Christie), a position we also filled in the 4 x 440 yards event (Jones, Stower, Clubb, Pack).
